items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: I know, I met Willie at Papa John's shop.

ctx.x: Did you ever see Billy Kersams? That's before my time. Yeah. I heard of Billy Kersams and Black Patty, but I... Yeah, I heard about him from playing up there from somebody. Maybe Charlie Love or somebody told me about him. That's way before my time. It's so, it's so hard to keep all that straight, all those guys. Well, I guess that just about covers Clarinet Williams except...

Yeah, yeah, I don't remember George Foster from out there. I don't remember George Foster and his brother. Willie? Willie. I know, I met Willie at Papa John's shop. He was a bricklayer or a plasterer or something like that. But now right after that he came there and told us he was going to Baton Rouge. That's the last I heard of Willie Foster. But I don't know George, but I know they got a sister. But she died. She was living right at the next corner. Oh, yeah? She was a friend of my mother. She played a lot of…
She played guitar. Did she play in jazz bands or the sister? No. Sister.
